WP-009 documentation pipeline PASS with one unmet criterion: AC-3 (api-surface.md documents BodyRoute interface and dispatchBodyRoute() function signature). This criterion cannot be met because it depends on WP-005 (Server Route Dispatch Refactor) which was CANCELLED — the BodyRoute interface and dispatchBodyRoute() function were never implemented in server.ts. Three of four WP-009 criteria are met: file-tree.md updated with config-helpers.test.ts (AC-1), config.js coordinator-only entry confirmed (AC-2), .context/ regenerated (AC-4). AC-3 is a deferred deliverable that should seed the next plan cycle's documentation work once the server.ts route dispatch is implemented.

Reopened CANCELLED work package WP-005 to READY. Reason: Server route dispatch refactor (BodyRoute + dispatchBodyRoute + handleRequest() reduction) was never implemented — server.ts remains at 1994 lines with 18 inline try/catch blocks. WP-009 AC-3 (api-surface.md BodyRoute documentation) is unmet because this WP was cancelled before implementation began. Reopening to complete the plan's primary maintainability deliverable.

Cross-cutting synthesis observation: Two Medium-priority info-disclosure findings (UUID reflection in handleUpdateAssignments and handleReplaceAssignedModel) were confirmed by the Security Auditor in WP-003 but deferred from this cycle. Both share the same root cause pattern as the persona-key fix already shipped. A single follow-on WP targeting api-models.ts lines 371–377 and 432–442 would close the full OWASP A05 class in the Model Registry API handlers.

outcome_summary: This rework cycle successfully addressed all actionable technical debt, security hardening, and test-coverage gaps from the prior model-settings project. The primary achievements were: the server.ts route dispatch refactor (handleRequest() reduced from ~448 to 55 lines via a declarative BodyRoute table), config.js decomposition into three focused files (~1,395 to 181 lines), elimination of the info-disclosure error message in handleUpdateAssignments(), orchestrator glob widening for two-digit persona files, and 60 new unit tests. All 9 work packages completed with zero test failures and 3,593/3,593 tests passing; two Medium-priority UUID-reflection info-disclosure findings were identified and deferred for a targeted follow-on cycle.
project_summary: Refactor the GUI server and frontend code introduced by the model-settings project to improve maintainability, fix a security info-disclosure pattern, add client-side validation UX, future-proof the orchestrator's persona file discovery, and establish test coverage for previously untested GUI components. No new features — purely technical debt, security hardening, and test coverage.
